thread:
sam: quick brainstorm  i'm leaning toward a very small "prefetch lease" primitive on the gateway rather than a heavyweight prewarm API. client signals intent, gateway returns a signed short-lived lease id, gateway does non-committal warm work, client references lease on the real request. pros: narrow surface, easy rollback.
jun: +1. two immediate constraints: safety (no accidental writes), and hedging determinism. we need strict rules.
meera: safety rules proposal: default allowlist only for safe methods (GET/HEAD). for non-safe, require `Idempotency-Key` and route opt-in. prewarm requests must never be visible to downstream write handlers unless explicitly validated.
ben: hedging: lease binding wins. if client fires hedged requests, the gateway assigns the lease to a single upstream attempt deterministically (first-to-bind). others get `x-rw-prefetch-status: joined|ignored`. important for downstream caches and K/V materialization.
sam: wire sketch: client->gateway `POST /fast` with `x-rw-prefetch: intent; x-rw-prefetch-mode: conn,kv` -> gateway returns `103 Prefetch-Lease: id=tx9; ttl=450; sig=...` and starts warm. real request includes `x-rw-lease-id: tx9; x-rw-lease-sig: ...` so upstream can verify.
jun: love the attestation idea. upstream should verify lease signature and TTL before applying warmed state. prevents header forgery across internal proxies.
meera: streaming nuance: for streaming-start endpoints, initial metadata should include `prefetch-status: applied|miss|inflight`. if applied after stream opens, emit trailer `prefetch-applied: yes;cost_ms=...;state=materialized|ignored`. helps client decide whether to read early.
ben: config sample (yaml):
````
ingress:
  prefetch_lease:
    enabled: true
    default_ttl_ms: 450
    routes:
      - prefix: /fast
        methods: [GET]
    max_concurrent_per_tenant: 3
    safety: safe-by-default
````
meera: quota & anti-abuse: per-tenant token-bucket + global circuit breaker tied to upstream CPU/memory. reasons tagged (`quota|circuit|adaptive`). adaptive controller should reduce acceptance when hit_rate low or cost high.
sam: metrics to emit: `prefetch.attempts`, `prefetch.accepts`, `prefetch.hits`, `prefetch.miss_latency_delta_ms`, `prefetch.memory_delta_bytes`, `prefetch.reject_reason`. include tenant/route tags.
jun: billing: Hosted treat prefetch as non-billable for now; surface detailed metrics for Dedicated and allow opt-in billing via tenant flag. note this in RFC.
ben: failure model: prefetch must be strictly a hint. if warm errors, gateway proceeds normal path and sets `prefetch-status: miss;reason=error`. do not fail client requests for prewarm errors.
meera: hedging edge-case: if both hedged attempts present prewarm leases, pick the lease with lexicographically smaller id as deterministic tie-breaker after timestamp compare. document explicitly.
sam: implementation note: prefer warming upstream node-local caches or warming via an internal warm endpoint; avoid duplicating large K/V in the edge. lease table should be sharded and memory-bounded; evict aggressively.
infra-bot: canary report: prefetch-lease-proto v1 rolled to 12% on /fast: cold p95 down 110ms, upstream conn spikes +7% during lease windows, prefetch_rejects 2.1% (quota).
jun: action items: sam to open RFC "prefetch lease primitive (attested)" with header spec + signing, meera to write safety/idempotency rules, ben to draft hedging/tiebreaker appendix, infra to add metrics dashboard. schedule follow-up eng-arch sync next Wed.
ops-bot: RFC created: https://rfc.internal/r/5987-prefetch-lease-primitive
sam: cool, moving to RFC review.
